Intermediate.learningGoal: Write generic functions with upper bounds and understand declaration-site variance.
gotchas: List<out E> is covariant, MutableList<E> is invariant
Type erasure: is List<String> cannot be checked at runtime
Comparing a T without a Comparable bound does not compile
goodSolutionShows: out and in used where the type is only produced or consumed
shapeHints: a read-only Box<out T> and a Sink<in T>

Advanced.learningGoal: Use reified type parameters, star projections and use-site variance.
gotchas: Star projection hides the type, so reads are Any? and writes impossible
goodSolutionShows: Correct use-site variance when copying between collections
Type-safe heterogeneous container with KClass keys
shapeHints: a typed registry keyed by KClass
a copy function from MutableList<in T> to List<out T>
a generic parse helper using reified T

Expert.learningGoal: Design variance-correct APIs and handle type-system corner cases.
gotchas: Variance conflicts when a covariant type appears in an input position
Nothing as a subtype enabling covariant empty values
goodSolutionShows: Sealed generic hierarchies with out T
shapeHints: a covariant Either with Nothing-typed Left or Right
a typed key-value store with safe getters
